events.title: Scanning Infrastructure Configuration
events.description: Inspecting perimeter gateway routes and RustFS object storage permissions...

events.title: Critical Finding Identified: Unauthenticated API Route Exposure
events.description: Perimeter gateway route /api/records has allow_anonymous=true. Anonymous requests retrieve patient diagnosis data.

events.title: Retrieved Guidance: Perimeter API Gateway Authentication Enforcement
events.description: Configure gateway authorizers to require valid JWT/Bearer credentials. Return HTTP 401 Unauthorized for missing tokens.

events.title: Agent Formulation of Remediation Plan
events.description: Agent preparing candidate policy. Testing perimeter access restriction on Apex Medical gateway.

events.title: Captured Immutable Baseline Snapshot (rev-002)
events.description: State hash: sha256:6910e44e40c9f79d. Registered rollback target prior to mutation.

events.title: Applying Candidate Policy 1: Blanket Route Restriction
events.description: Enforcing emergency perimeter deny rule on /api/records to immediately seal exposure.

events.title: Executing Dual Verification Protocol (Candidate 1)
events.description: Running independent Security attack probes and Application workflow probes concurrently...

events.title: Security Probe Result: PASS (Anonymous Blocked)
events.description: Anonymous caller received HTTP 403 Forbidden. Attack vector is closed.

events.title: Application Probe Result: FAIL (Analyst Blocked)
events.description: CRITICAL: Legitimate Security Analyst was blocked with HTTP 403! Clinical records workflow broken.

events.title: Application Workflow Regression Detected!
events.description: Candidate policy closed security exposure but broke legitimate Security Analyst workflow (HTTP 403 on /api/records).

events.title: Triggering Automated Rollback to Snapshot rev-002
events.description: Restoring baseline configuration hash sha256:6910e44e40c9f79d...

events.title: Agent Reflection & Root Cause Analysis
events.description: Candidate policy was overly restrictive: blanket denial on /api/records severed authorized analyst access. Replanning with fine-grained role-based authorizer granting analyst and admin identities while rejecting anonymous requests.

events.title: Synthesizing Least-Privilege Policy (Candidate 2)
events.description: Configuring gateway authorizer: allow_anonymous=false, required_roles=["analyst", "admin"]. Preserving /health for anonymous uptime checks.

events.title: Applying Safer Least-Privilege Configuration
events.description: Deploying calibrated route authorization rules to perimeter gateway...

events.title: Final Dual Verification Protocol
events.description: Running comprehensive suite of Security Attack probes and Application Health probes...

events.title: Self-Healing Remediation Successful
events.description: Data protected from anonymous access + application workflow verified intact for authorized analysts.

events.title: Critical Finding Identified: Unauthenticated API Route Exposure
events.description: Perimeter gateway route /api/records has allow_anonymous=true. Anonymous requests retrieve patient diagnosis data.

events.title: Retrieved Guidance: Perimeter API Gateway Authentication Enforcement
events.description: Configure gateway authorizers to require valid JWT/Bearer credentials. Return HTTP 401 Unauthorized for missing tokens.

events.title: Agent Formulation of Remediation Plan
events.description: Agent preparing candidate policy. Testing perimeter access restriction on Apex Medical gateway.

events.title: Captured Immutable Baseline Snapshot (rev-002)
events.description: State hash: sha256:6910e44e40c9f79d. Registered rollback target prior to mutation.

events.title: Applying Candidate Policy 1: Blanket Route Restriction
events.description: Enforcing emergency perimeter deny rule on /api/records to immediately seal exposure.

events.title: Executing Dual Verification Protocol (Candidate 1)
events.description: Running independent Security attack probes and Application workflow probes concurrently...

events.title: Security Probe Result: PASS (Anonymous Blocked)
events.description: Anonymous caller received HTTP 403 Forbidden. Attack vector is closed.

events.title: Application Probe Result: FAIL (Analyst Blocked)
events.description: CRITICAL: Legitimate Security Analyst was blocked with HTTP 403! Clinical records workflow broken.

events.title: Application Workflow Regression Detected!
events.description: Candidate policy closed security exposure but broke legitimate Security Analyst workflow (HTTP 403 on /api/records).

events.title: Triggering Automated Rollback to Snapshot rev-002
events.description: Restoring baseline configuration hash sha256:6910e44e40c9f79d...

events.title: Agent Reflection & Root Cause Analysis
events.description: Candidate policy was overly restrictive: blanket denial on /api/records severed authorized analyst access. Replanning with fine-grained role-based authorizer granting analyst and admin identities while rejecting anonymous requests.

events.title: Synthesizing Least-Privilege Policy (Candidate 2)
events.description: Configuring gateway authorizer: allow_anonymous=false, required_roles=["analyst", "admin"]. Preserving /health for anonymous uptime checks.

events.title: Applying Safer Least-Privilege Configuration
events.description: Deploying calibrated route authorization rules to perimeter gateway...

events.description: Running comprehensive suite of Security Attack probes and Application Health probes...
